race.comment: HIGH RETURN NZ (1) resumes from a spell of nine weeks after closing off last campaign in good form, the last run being a solid third over 1609m at Central Southland Raceway. Has the benefit of a good draw. Likely to run a big race to kick off this campaign. AIR FORCE MAJOR (5) kicked off his career in good style two weeks ago, beaten 6 metres into second over 1700m at Cowra. Primary contender in a similar assignment. PORCUPINE CREEK NZ (6) is on the radar after her last-start fourth over 1730m at Bathurst a week-and-a-half ago. HANDLE BARS DOWN (11) must be considered after he finished runner-up over 1700m at this track eight days ago.
